home.heroTitle: Professional cleaning, with a clear price from the first tap
home.heroSubtitle: Get a quote and book in under two minutes from your phone. No phone calls, no walkthroughs, no surprises on the invoice.

trust.priceBody: The estimate you see when booking is what you pay. No hidden fees.
trust.bookingBody: Pick your service, size and time slot. We confirm instantly.
trust.insuredBody: Vetted cleaners, covered by liability insurance.

how.step1Body: Answer a few questions and watch your price update live.
how.step2Body: Choose the day and hour that work for you.
how.step3Body: We arrive with everything. You don't have to prep a thing.

home.finalCtaBody: Get your price now. No card needed to see the estimate.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Five kinds of cleaning, each priced by its own rules. Pick what you need and get the price instantly.

residencial.name: Residential cleaning
residencial.description: Regular or deep cleaning of your home. Choose the level and add extras like fridge, oven or organizing.

airbnb.name: Airbnb / Turnover
airbnb.description: Fast turnaround between stays: fresh linens, restocked amenities and the place ready for the next check-in.

mudanza.name: Move-in / Move-out
mudanza.description: Deep cleaning of an empty property. Built for getting your deposit back or walking into a spotless home.

comercial.name: Commercial
comercial.description: Offices, clinics and retail spaces. Priced per square foot, with standard or deep cleaning.

postconstruccion.name: Post-construction
postconstruccion.description: Fine dust, construction debris and adhesive residue removed. Always a deep clean, priced per square foot.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Every price here comes from the same table the booking flow uses. What you see is exactly what you're charged.
pricing.minimumBody: No job is quoted below {amount}, regardless of size.
pricing.paymentBody: Nothing is charged when you book. We'll send a payment link for the full total once the job is done.
pricing.frequencyBody: Book recurring service and the discount applies automatically to every visit.
pricing.note: These are starting prices. The booking flow adjusts for pets, add-ons and frequency.

about.title: About us
about.lead: We're a cleaning crew in {city} who think booking a service shouldn't take three phone calls and a site visit.
about.body1: So we built a quote tool that gives you the real price before you talk to anyone. Pick what you need, see what it costs, book it. No middlemen, no haggling.
about.body2: We work with vetted, insured cleaners and products that are safe around kids and pets. If something isn't right, we come back.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Got a question before you book? Reach out.
contact.bookingNote: You don't need to call to book: the quote tool prices and schedules it on the spot.

policies.title: Policies
policies.intro: Booking and cancellation rules. Short, and no fine print.
policies.noticeBody: Bookings need at least {hours} hours of notice. Slots that don't meet that window show up blocked on the calendar.
policies.cancelBody: Nothing is charged when you book, so canceling ahead of the appointment costs you nothing. We just ask for at least {hours} hours notice so we can offer that slot to someone else.
policies.paymentBody: Nothing is charged when you book. Once the job is done, we send a payment link for the full total.
policies.hoursBody: We work every day, weekends included, from {start} to {end}.

lavanderia.name: Laundry
lavanderia.description: One load washed, dried and folded.

gabinetes.name: Inside cabinets
gabinetes.description: Kitchen cabinets emptied and wiped inside.

organizacion_1h.name: Organizing — 1 hour
organizacion_1h.description: An hour spent on closets, pantry or shared areas.

sabanas.name: Linen change
sabanas.description: Beds stripped and made with the linens you leave out.

amenities.name: Restock amenities
amenities.description: Paper, soap, coffee and basics for the next guest.

service.title: What needs cleaning?
service.subtitle: Everything after this adapts to what you pick here.

level.subtitle: A deep clean takes longer and reaches what you don't see.

pets.title: Any pets at home?
pets.subtitle: Pet hair takes extra time and filters, which is why we ask.
